note: Layers are square transparent PNGs on one shared canvas (authored at 2000x2000, shipped at 1000x1000), so they stack with no offsets. Draw in list order, first = bottom. An accessory layer must be a square transparent PNG drawn on the same canvas; it is inserted at a slot: 'after' = directly above the named layer, 'before' = directly below it. Do not trim layers. Source: Erika's Jalapresto_Instruments_Compilation.pdf (page 7 ukulele photo, 2026-11-11). The ukulele photo is turned to his guitar playing angle and sized to about 56% of the acoustic guitar; the guitar-pose fretting arm is shortened and its hand end moved along the neck so the arm passes behind the neck and the finger nubs sit on top. Slots as for his guitar poses.

clothing_torso.note: shirts, scarves, bow ties; stays under the face, guitar and arms

face.note: glasses, masks; above the eyes, brows, teeth and mustache

clothing_lower.note: skirts and dresses; over the legs and boots, under the instrument and arms

monocle.note: monocle lens: above the eyes, under the teeth and mustache (the chain uses the face slot, over the mustache)
